name: Tide Pairs
description: A gentle memory game of sea creatures and shells. Turn two cards at a time and find every matching pair. A new deal each day, or as many as you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Sixteen face-down cards hide eight pairs of sea creatures and shells. Turn two cards at a time; matching cards stay up.
help.goal: Find all the pairs in as few turns as you like. There is no timer and no wrong answer.
howToPlay: Turn a card, then turn a second card. That is one turn.
If the two match, they stay face up. If not, they turn back after a short pause. Pressing another card turns them back at once.
With reduced motion on, an unmatched pair stays showing until you press any card.
Daily deal is the same for everyone today. New deal gives a fresh one. Bigger switches to 12 pairs, and Smaller goes back to 8.
Your fewest turns is remembered for each board size.

controls.action: Jump to the start or end of the row
Reach Daily deal, New deal and Bigger

tips: Each card has a shape, a colour and a name, so you can tell them apart without colour.
Start in one corner and work across, so you remember where each card was.
You can stop at any time. Your game is saved. An unmatched pair turns back when you return.
